subject: With multiple accounts, RStudio cannot update existing app

messages.author: 26b647b408a2e02e
messages.subject: With multiple accounts, RStudio cannot update existing app
parts:
I have one shiny app that was deployed to account A at first, then deployed to account B as a temporary site. After a while when I tried to update the app, I can only update to A but not B.

In RStudio the "publish to server" dialog will recognize existing url in account A with a "Update" label, and I can just update it. However for account B the existing url is not recognized, and "publish" button will try to create a new app with same app name, which got conflicted with existing app, so I got a url of app2 instead. Every update will generate an new app.

I believe it's the RStudio dialog didn't recognize the dcf file other than the first one, even the dcf file is in the proper place.

messages.subject: Re: With multiple accounts, RStudio cannot update existing app
parts:

rsconnect::deployApp(... appName = "app", ...) 

Then publish again generate this command

rsconnect::deployApp(... appName = "app2", ...) 

So the command already assigned the new name, the deployment was going as instructed.

It should be a problem in RStudio.

messages.author: 5893d17d64b5b0c2
messages.subject: Re: With multiple accounts, RStudio cannot update existing app
parts:
If you've deployed the application to multiple places, you need to choose which one you want to update (you currently can't change this in the dialog itself).

To do this, click the small triangle to the right of the Publish button. This should show a list of the places you have deployed the app in a small drop-down menu. Click on the one you want to update, and the Publish dialog should appear with the settings for updating.

Let us know if that works for you!

Jonathan.

messages.author: 26b647b408a2e02e
messages.subject: Re: With multiple accounts, RStudio cannot update existing app
parts:
Thanks for the tip, this turned out be not a bug, but a design limit.

Here is the drop down list


So it cannot differentiate two accounts in shinyapps.io with same app name, the designer probably didn't think about this case.

In the deploy dialog one can switch between accounts, so this switch is different from the drop down list, and if you didn't choose the right one, the dialog cannot find the existing app info based on server name.

I found the drop down list before but didn't find the use of it, since all the items in it is same by name. 

I guess users are not expected to deploy same app to different accounts in shinyapps.io, so the design is understandable.

messages.author: 26b647b408a2e02e
messages.subject: Re: With multiple accounts, RStudio cannot update existing app
parts:
That's good news!

I realized how this works now:

1. the drop down list came from the .dcf files found in app directory
2. with the drop down item selected, the site/account/app info was put on top of the list (so when you chose different item, the order of server will change), and it can be updated. 
3. other server in list can only create new app.

Before I found out the drop down list(I found it but didn't understand what it is since they have same name), my intuitive understanding is

1. when I switched between server/accounts, some of them remembered the previous deployment entry, some don't.
2. because the "create new" and "update previous" used same UI, I didn't realize the "update previous" must rely on the drop down list selection, which is not visible in the dialog if not noticed.

I'll suggest to use a different design:

1. the drop down list should be a part of dialog. selecting drop down list need several careful clicks, and you still need to check the dialog after the selection. 
2. in the dialog, all drop down items should be inside a panel called "previous deployment", selecting items will show detail of deployment, and user can update (or edit if it's possible) it.
3. there should be another panel/button "create new deployment", user can create new deployment by selecting servers, input app details.
